about: ENTERABLE PLACES (claude/villamark, rule enterable-places-findable): every place of the city you can walk INTO (a streamed interior cell on by default). Each one: a places entry (viewer/places.js, same id), a map marker (the 'enter' glyph: viewer/map/mapData.js merges this file into the map's landmarks), a Walk in prompt near its door (viewer/enterPrompt.js) and a share link ?place=<id>&view=third (viewer/main.js). City metres (x east, z south); heading = degrees clockwise from north (-z), the way the character faces at the entry spot. door = the opening you walk through; entry = the spot outside it (street / forecourt, outside every building footprint); mark = where the map marker sits. Checked by tools/audit/enterableCheck.mjs (gate row enterable).
